capabilities: Sync the current note or selected notes to a configured GitHub repository
Apply framework presets for post paths, image paths, and frontmatter conventions
Commit local images in the same commit and rewrite Markdown and wiki image links to public site paths
Track per-note sync status, including Modified after local changes, on a filterable status page
Sync via direct commits to the target branch or pull requests from a custom branch
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool; it publishes selected notes to a GitHub blog repository, one manual sync at a time.
extras: Desktop-only. Manual sync only; no automatic watcher or scheduled sync. Token must start with ghp_; OAuth not supported. Local images only (no PicGo or image hosting). Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes to a self-hosted Markdown static-site blog, including converting image links and filling frontmatter per framework conventions.

relations.evidence: Blog Bridge sends requests to the GitHub REST API to read repository refs, create blobs, commits, branches, and pull requests

requires.name: GitHub account with a blog repository
GitHub classic personal access token (ghp_ prefix)

summary: Syncs selected Obsidian notes to GitHub-backed Markdown static-site blogs (Hexo, Hugo, Jekyll, Astro, VitePress, MkDocs) with image handling and sync status tracking.
